code.tree_clean_means: git status --porcelain -- pipeline tests PREANALYSIS.md, run in the gizmo folder, printed nothing (untracked files included), so the commit is the code that ran
code.code_identity_means: git rev-parse --verify HEAD:./<path>, run in the gizmo folder, for pipeline, tests and PREANALYSIS.md: the git tree id of pipeline and of tests and the blob id of the plan at the commit. An id depends only on the content under its path, so with tree_clean true the three ids are the code and the plan that ran, whatever else the repository's commit holds. A resumed run is refused unless all three equal the manifest's (Joe, 2026-11-20, D-122: "Compare code identity"); the commit is recorded and not compared

body.plan_section: Reconciliation rows (reported first, whatever they show), Row U (Ryu and Hiatt), steps U0 to U3
body.builder: reconciliation_treatment cumulative-MW treatments supplied per step (RowUInputs)
body.estimator: reconciliation_mu.run_u_step (ln price on ln(MW + 1), utility and year effects, by state) per step, the ownership estimates and U0's pooled estimate returned as comparisons under our specification with no verdict; u1_sentence (the adopted U1 sentences, D-109)
labels: reconciliation row: the paper's specification on our panel, reported first whatever it shows

comparisons under our specification, comparison-only by Joe's ruling of 2026-11-19 (D-109), no reproduction verdict; the paper's figure and band are beside the pooled estimate as a comparison band, and the ownership ordering is uncontrolled
not applicable: an estimator other than the selected procedure, so no validation is claimed (None is kept for the validated headline alone)
body.needs_before_research_data: RunInputs.reconciliation_u (RowUInputs) and RunInputs.reconciliation_u_inputs_are (INVENTED_INPUTS or RESEARCH_DATA_AFTER_THE_FREEZE; with no value the row stops in words and none is chosen for the caller). On research data the row is refused in words, before any step, without the gate file and the run's authorization, with a Short Form code other than the adopted one (D-115), or with a specification not equal to reconciliation_mu.ryu_spec(reconciliation_mu.U_SHORT_FORM_ADOPTED_CODE) (session 27; refusing a departure in any other field is the session's reading of the fixed specification). The specification is fixed: reconciliation_mu.ryu_spec(reconciliation_mu.U_SHORT_FORM_ADOPTED_CODE), that is 'unit_years_filed', the Short Form rule adopted by Joe on 2026-11-20 (D-115); every other field is this study's approximation adopted by Joe on 2026-11-19 (D-107; U0's assignment D-109) or the paper's own value, refused in words if departed from. sample_flags come from short_form_filers.adopted_row_u_flags (its choices are short_form_filers.ADOPTED_ROW_U_CHOICES, the one named place) on a frame that covers every outcome unit-year reaching the Short Form filter, built from the filer table data/interim/reconciliation_short_form_filers.parquet (18,172 rows, one for each utility, state and year with a row in the Short Form table, written by the one authorized read of 2026-11-20, D-113) and the 2019 flags in data/interim/reconciliation_short_form_flags.parquet, both already on disk, and never from a new read under data/raw. Step U3's window is 2015 to 2025, so the flags are built with step_window=(2015, 2025), the adopted rule applied year by year over the step's own window; one frame of 2015 to 2025 built that way serves every step, since a filing counts for its own year alone (the session's reading, which Joe may strike). On the records no 2025 unit-year of the quantity panel has a filer-table row (1,362 unit-years, 0 with a record of a filing; data/frozen/reconciliation_mu_design.json). An outcome unit-year the frame does not cover stops the step in words and it is recorded as not computed; whether the frame covers every outcome unit-year cannot be shown before outcomes are read. Short Form exclusion as adopted by Joe on 2026-11-20 (D-115): a utility-state-year leaves where a record shows a Short Form filing, a row in the Short Form table that year or, for 2019, a flag of true in the operational file. Every other unit-year is kept with no record of a filing, which is no claim about whether it filed. The three-year count is taken after the exclusion. The 2019 exclusion is explicitly incomplete. The table has no 2019 rows, the exclusion that year rests on the operational file's flags, and a 2019 unit-year with a missing flag or with no flags row is kept with no record either way. A missing flag or an absent row does not establish non-filing. The sample is still not the paper's sample, and the row is comparison-only (D-109). Outcome availability (whether a unit-year has a price) is not used in place of the paper's Short Form exclusion (Joe, 2026-11-19, D-109). On the quantity side (data/frozen/reconciliation_mu_design.json, short_form_flags_for_row_u), the frame with no exclusion has 16,648 unit-years and 1,808 utilities; one flagged unit-year of 2019 leaves directly, and the same utility's 2023 and 2024 leave through the three-year requirement, leaving 16,645 unit-years and 1,807 utilities. Of the frame's 1,974 unit-years of 2019, 1 has a flag of true, 1,780 have a missing flag and 193 have no flags row, the last two kept with no record either way. The filer table has rows in each year from 2012 to 2018 and from 2020 to 2025 and none in 2019; of its 13,090 unit-years in row U's window of 2015 to 2024, none has a row in the quantity panel (data/interim/panel_quantities.parquet). No price is read for these counts, so the paper's missing-price drop is not applied and this is not the paper's sample. The paper's 1,798 utilities retained and its Short Form group of approximately 560 are printed beside ours for comparison only and are no part of any reason. U0's treatment is cumulative_mw on reconciliation_treatment.assign_polygon_smallest(sites, data/interim/reconciliation_polygon_incidence.parquet, data/interim/panel_reported_ids.parquet, **ROW_U_POLYGON), the smallest containing polygon over every polygon with the type not read, our labelled approximation (D-109), built on the real quantity files 2026-11-19 (2,157 of 2,203 data center sites mapped to a panel unit; one exact area tie listed, not broken; that site has no assigned polygon, is listed apart in the entity-type list and counts in "lying in any" (adopted by Joe on 2026-11-19, D-111)). It is the same rule and the same assignment as C0 to C2, which is not independent validation. U1 to U3 need a cumulative-MW treatment on the inventory's site-year load (reconciliation_treatment.cumulative_mw, mw_source 'site_year_load'). The ownership classes are reconciliation_mu.adopted_row_u_ownership_classes(q), on quantities that cover 2001 to 2025 (a subset of years is refused in words). Each utility-state's class comes from the panel's entity type, the utility-level modal reported type carried across the panel to every year and state of the utility, and not the latest year-by-year EIA classification (D-119), read as the last nonmissing value of the panel's entity_type column over 2001 to 2025 (D-117), which on this panel returns that same type for every utility-state; the years searched are the quantity panel's 2001 to 2025, and the class is time-invariant, mapped by reconciliation_mu.U_MAP unchanged, settled by Joe on 2026-11-20 (D-117), the type described as his ruling of the same day states (D-119) (reconciliation_mu.OWNERSHIP_SPECIFICATION_D117). A utility-state with no entity type in any year searched gets no class. Under row U it leaves the sample, as a utility not reporting ownership-type data (Ryu and Hiatt p. 6). Under row C it is absent from the mapping, and ownership_split stops in words. A missing type is never read as any ownership class. The panel's entity_type is one type per utility id, the type its own filings report most often, so on this panel the reading over the years searched changes no class. Joe ruled on 2026-11-20 (D-119) that rows U and C keep this type, described as the utility-level modal reported type carried across the panel and not the latest year-by-year EIA classification, with no further raw-data investigation (his words are reconciliation_mu.OWNERSHIP_RULING_D119_WORDS); no claim is made that it equals EIA's year-by-year record (reconciliation_mu.PANEL_ENTITY_TYPE_STATEMENT). Outcome frames res_price_default_service and res_price. No assigned site is not proof of no facility. No step returns a reproduction verdict (D-107, D-109); u1_sentence returns the adopted U1 sentence chosen by whether our co-op and municipal coefficients are each above our investor-owned one, by a strict comparison of our point estimates, exactly equal coefficients giving "not each above" and no test entering the choice (adopted by Joe on 2026-11-19, D-111), and u1_indistinguishable decides nothing.

assignment.value: Our smallest-polygon approximation, not the paper's assignment. Each site goes to the smallest territory polygon that strictly contains it, over every polygon of the layer, the polygon's type not read (ours, a labelled approximation adopted by Joe on 2026-11-19, D-109). The paper gives priority to retail providers over wholesale-only territories (Ryu and Hiatt p. 5, Sec. 2.1). This layer's TYPE field does not establish which polygons are retail, so that priority is not applied, and exact reproduction of the paper's assignment is unavailable; the layer's vintage is also not the paper's. A site in two polygons of identical smallest area is listed with both and not placed (the tie is not broken), and a site in no polygon is listed and enters no utility. This is the same rule as row C's assignment at C0 to C2, so the two assignments agree by construction; that agreement is one rule applied twice and is not independent validation.

steps.missing_coverage: No assigned site is not proof of no facility. A unit with no site assigned to it under the polygon rule, or under the inventory's own assignment, is not shown to have no data center. A site outside every polygon, a site in an exact area tie, a site the inventory does not list, or a polygon whose utility is not a panel unit all leave a unit with no assigned site. Missing territory coverage is never evidence of no treatment.
